title: selaginella apiculata
intro: Selaginella apiculata, commonly known as Spike-moss or Spike-club moss, is a type of plant belonging to the family Selaginellaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella apiculata are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, lower blood pressure, and show antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its various health benefits.
